name: A Land of Tears
source:
Their parents told them to amuse themselves while they did their shopping in the neighboring town, but the two got lost. 

Entera is now trying to get home with his brother – but there is a curse on these lands. Music tries to invade your mind, and there is something about the rain that’s frightening the townspeople.

[From [url=https://reynadiai.itch.io/a-land-of-tears]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
父母让他们去邻镇购物，让他们自娱自乐，但两人迷路了。

Entera现在正试图与他的兄弟一起回家 - 但这些土地上有一个诅咒。音乐试图侵入你的心灵，而雨中的某些东西让镇上的人们感到害怕。

[来自[url=https://reynadiai.itch.io/a-land-of-tears]Itch.io[/url]]
